file: 264 Throw Food For Animals Is a Roblox Hit With 120000 Players.mp4

lines.t: This new fun game on Roblox is about throwing food as far as you can, to feed wild animals. Yes, that's the whole game.

full.credit: Clips: FoltynPlays; BachaBlox; CaylusBlox (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

sc.big:
THIS NEW FUN
GAME ON ROBLOX

lines.t: Throw food, and you attract animals from different areas. Buy better food, and you attract rarer animals.

full.credit: Clips: FoltynPlays; BachaBlox; CaylusBlox (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

sc.sub: THE RARE ONES ARE WORTH IT

lines.t: Your animals earn you money, and you train on pull-up stands to throw even farther.

full.credit: Clips: FoltynPlays; BachaBlox; CaylusBlox (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: It came out in September, and over 120,000 people are playing it right now. It has over 55 million visits.

full.credit: Clips: FoltynPlays; BachaBlox; CaylusBlox (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: What's the rarest animal you'd want?

full.credit: Clips: FoltynPlays; BachaBlox; CaylusBlox (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)
